_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Applied changes stay live until the game: Applied changes stay live until the game exits. Save writes them to the file.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Could not write the file. See the log fo: Could not write the file. See the log for details.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Discard unsaved and applied changes to t: Discard unsaved and applied changes to this file.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Inactive: General > Butt physics engine: Inactive: General > Butt physics engine is set to PPA built-in.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Requires CBPC. This path hooks CBPC inte: Requires CBPC. This path hooks CBPC internals and may cause crashes.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Save, then restart the game to change th: Save, then restart the game to change the language.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Unsaved changes are applied automaticall: Unsaved changes are applied automatically when the menu closes.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Unsaved changes are saved automatically: Unsaved changes are saved automatically when the menu closes.
json:menu_translation/ppa:SKSE/Plugins/p.Writes every translatable string to ppa-: Writes every translatable string to ppa-translations/english.json. Copy it to <language>.json to start a translation.
